organizeWeek.name: a Sunday week: done of done-or-due, everything the grid shows
a Saturday week: today is its last day
the week’s first day: nothing is past yet
a Monday week asked on its Sunday
the same world with no subtask: the same answer
the paused errand resumed: on the week
a trip rests what falls inside it, except what was done
nothing on this week: an undated task and one next month
only a skip and an unrecorded past day: nothing counted
a finished one-off counts on its day

nextMilestoneAcross.name: a tie on the day: the goal listed first
a late milestone keeps its date
dated beats undated, whatever the order
undated only: the first goal’s first
an ended goal is passed over
reached and dropped are passed: the next open one
a custom type’s own done word, never a habit’s
a whole ISO stamp: its day
a trashed milestone is passed over
